shortDescription: Greece on Tuesday reported a central government primary budget surplus of 6.5 billion euros ($7.49 billion) for the eight months to August, versus a target surplus of 4.98 billion euros.The budget surplus excludes debt-servicing costs.($1 = 0.8675 euros)

children: Greece on Tuesday reported a central government primary budget surplus of 6.5 billion euros ($7.49 billion) for the eight months to August, versus a target surplus of 4.98 billion euros.
The budget surplus excludes debt-servicing costs.
